summary: The 2D graphics (Thebes) area tightened up font handling and platform font plumbing: safer locking around font maps, stronger ownership of webfont data after sanitization, better shaper validation, and renamed/standardized font properties (font-width). There are also telemetry and about:support entries showing HDR profile use and HDR display info. These changes improve font stability, correct shaping, and make it easier to diagnose font and HDR display issues.
